name: Keep3r Network
rootCause: On June 12, 2023, Keep3r Network on Ethereum was exploited after an attacker compromised the governor's private key, generated with weak entropy. The breach enabled privileged withdrawals of KP3R tokens, resulting in a loss near $200,000. The privileged governance address was generated as a vanity address, using insufficient randomness. This made the private key vulnerable to brute-force recovery, enabling full administrative takeover and unauthorized withdrawals.
